Group winners progress to winner's bracket, runners-up to the losers bracket. * Map picking: during signup, players nominate two maps to be tossed from the map-pool, this will be used to reduce the map-pool for each map to three maps (high-seed's #1 map tossed, then low-seed's #1, or low-seed's #2 if both players nominated same map for #1). Higher-seeded player picks first.
